info.title: RecruitRadar API
info.description: Local-only backend of RecruitRadar. It turns public job-posting data (three read-only ATS JSON APIs, CSV files and manual entries) into an evidence-backed view of observed hiring activity. There is no authentication: bind it to a loopback address (the default).

delete.summary: Remove a source and its data

post.summary: One read-only fetch of the board
post.description: Fetches the provider's public JSON once (one request per page), stores a snapshot and returns the run. A failed fetch still returns 200 with `status: failed`; it stores no snapshot and removes nothing. 429 `too_soon` when the source was refreshed within the minimum interval.

Rows are validated one by one; valid rows are stored as an additive snapshot and invalid ones come back in `errors` with their 1-based line number. Answers 201 when at least one row was stored and 200 when none was. A file-level problem (empty file, missing header, duplicate header, unterminated quote, over the size limits) is 422 `invalid_csv`.

200.description: No row was valid; nothing stored

get.description: Derived by replaying every stored snapshot through the pure analysis engine; nothing derived is stored.

dataset_label.title: Dataset Label
dataset_label.description: Becomes the source_ref of the import (1-200).

csv_text.title: Csv Text
csv_text.description: UTF-8 CSV text, at most 1 MB.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; blank means the import time.

a_key.title: A Key
a_key.description: Company key; must sort strictly before b_key.

snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
snapshot_id.description: Id of the stored snapshot (the latest when rows carry several observed_at); null when no row was accepted.

work_mode.title: Work Mode
work_mode.description: remote | hybrid | onsite | unknown (blank means unknown).

include_keywords.title: Include Keywords
include_keywords.description: At most 50 keywords of at most 60 characters.

exclude_keywords.title: Exclude Keywords
exclude_keywords.description: At most 50 keywords of at most 60 characters.

line.title: Line

note.title: Note
note.description: Omit to keep the stored note.

token.title: Token
token.description: Board token / site / board name (never a URL).

company_name.title: Company Name
company_name.description: The company this board belongs to (1-200 characters).

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The watched ATS source, when there is one.

last_observed_at.title: Last Observed At
last_observed_at.description: Newest snapshot of this source at as_of.

base_host.title: Base Host
base_host.description: The host a refresh of this source contacts.

last_ok_at.title: Last Ok At
last_ok_at.description: finished_at of the newest successful run.
